dedupe_keys.name: data used in understanding spatiotemporal patterns and drivers of urban flooding using municipal reports

description: Data used in "Understanding spatiotemporal patterns and drivers of urban flooding using municipal reports" is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Stacie DeSousa (deposited on HydroShare). This supports the article entitled "Understanding spatiotemporal patterns and drivers of urban flooding using municipal reports". This resource includes the R codes and data (imperviousness, rainfall, flood reports, topography, census data) used for the analysis. This resource contains information from the “City of Denver Open Data Catalog” (. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2024-09-17 and last updated 2024-11-11; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
